crossRefs.note: Everyone who passes over to those who are counted, from twenty years old and upward, shall give the offering to Yahweh.
The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less, than the half shekel, when they give the offering of…
Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
crossRefs.keyword: shall give this. Heb. shall be for. for. or, with

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “All the people of the land shall give to this offering for the prince in Israel.
translations.bsb: All the people of the land must participate in this contribution for the prince in Israel.
translations.kjv: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
translations.asv: All the people of the land shall give unto this oblation for the prince in Israel.
